name: Necrotic Resurrection
notes: Each cast costs 3 Favor; at fewer than 3 Favor the rest goes into Heresy (e.g. 1 Favor -> 2 Heresy). Risen summons can't be healed: the Lantern's Holy Light and other ally heals skip them (vanilla PlayerHeal heals any actor on your team, so the build has to exclude them). Level numbers are a first pass. Open questions: cast on the body nearest your aim or all bodies in an area; do summons last until killed or have a duration; what happens past the summon cap (oldest dies?); can elites and bosses leave bodies.
summary: Reanimate an intact body left by Call of Heresy as a loyal summon that fights for you. Each raise costs 3 Favor stacks.
